# Keep the upstream parser build private, static and independent of system packages.
set(EXPAT_BUILD_TOOLS OFF)
set(EXPAT_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF)
set(EXPAT_BUILD_TESTS OFF)
set(EXPAT_BUILD_DOCS OFF)
set(EXPAT_BUILD_FUZZERS OFF)
set(EXPAT_BUILD_PKGCONFIG OFF)
set(EXPAT_ENABLE_INSTALL OFF)
set(EXPAT_SHARED_LIBS OFF)
set(EXPAT_SYMBOL_VERSIONING OFF)
set(EXPAT_DTD OFF)
set(EXPAT_GE ON)
set(EXPAT_NS ON)
set(EXPAT_CHAR_TYPE char)
add_subdirectory(upstream EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
add_library(bridge_expat ALIAS expat)
